mentions.name: EnclaveOS
mentions.description: This project builds FOSS primitives for tamper-evident secure enclaves, with the goal of making secure enclaves as much of a default on the internet as TLS.
mentions.problem: Tamper-evident secure enclaves are not yet a default on the internet the way TLS is.
